design.decision: Bid with roughly four extra [A]s spread across suits, and buy [J]s and [Q]s cheaply because they turn into winners.
design.opponent: Shown when a converted [A] wins; opponents face duplicate [A]s and have to trump early rather than wait to cash honors.
design.rationale: Source-filtered upgrades are the enablers that measure well, and this is the rare step above ua-kings-become-aces, with a broader source and about twice the cards. It is buyable before any build because it adds winners. If it breaks the 12-pt ceiling, the fallback is "Every [Q]".
design.draftText: Opening: Every [J] through [Q] your team holds becomes an [A]

critic.concerns: The become-[A] family is crowded (cb-become-ace, ua-become-three-aces, ua-kings-become-aces, ub-low-to-aces, uc-junk-to-aces, ua-twos-become-aces), and "[J] through [Q]" reads awkwardly for a two-rank range.
